alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 26 at 1:18AM EDT until October 27 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 mph with frequent gusts up to 40
mph expected for metro and coastal areas of Miami-Dade, Broward,
and Palm Beach counties.

* WHERE...Coastal Broward, Coastal Miami Dade, Coastal Palm Beach,
Metro Broward, Metro Palm Beach, and Metropolitan Miami Dade
Counties.

* WHEN...From 11 AM this morning to 8 PM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
